Plausible's team does not access customer data on a routine basis; access is limited to cases such as support requests or system maintenance.
Plausible uses a limited number of subprocessors where necessary, carefully selected and bound by data protection agreements.

When SSO is first configured for a team, existing members can still log in with email and password, but once a member signs in via the identity provider their account becomes SSO-only and they can no longer use standard login credentials.
Team Owners retain the ability to log in with email and password even after using SSO, to allow troubleshooting of SSO configuration or a malfunctioning identity provider.
Plausible does not support SSO logins initiated directly from the identity provider's portal, for security reasons; users must always start logging in from Plausible's login form.
The official Data Studio connector lets users build custom dashboards, branded client reports, and views that blend Plausible data with other sources like ad spend or CRM data.
Plausible offers a stats API for viewing Plausible stats elsewhere.
Plausible has a Data Studio connector for custom reports and dashboards using Plausible data.
Plausible's compliance documentation covers GDPR, CCPA and data processing.
Stripe, Mozilla, Basecamp, Ghost, Hugging Face, Home Assistant, MongoDB, the Python Software Foundation and Harvard University are among the organizations using Plausible.
Plausible does not use cookies and does not collect personal data.
Plausible shows what's happening on a website right now, including where traffic is coming from, which pages are being viewed, and which goals are being met, in real time

The Business plan is needed for funnels, user journeys, revenue tracking, custom properties, Stats API or Data Studio, which can build custom dashboards and blend Plausible data with other sources like ad spend or CRM data.
The Enterprise plan is for large scale needs and includes SSO, Sites API, managed proxy or raw data exports.
On Enterprise plans, limits that can be increased beyond standard plan tiers include monthly pageview volume, number of sites, number of team members, API rate limits and data retention.
Plausible does not use cookies, persistent identifiers, or cross-site/cross-device tracking, and does not use site data for any other purposes.
Plausible's Growth plan costs $14/month and includes everything in Starter plus up to 3 sites and up to 3 team members.
Plausible's Business plan costs $19/month and includes everything in Growth plus up to 10 sites, up to 10 team members, 5 years of data retention, and a Stats API with 600 requests per hour.

assets.content:
Subject: Inspect a cookie-free analytics dashboard
Preview text: See the traffic sources, pages and goals Plausible reports in its public demo.

Hi there,

You can inspect Plausible Analytics’ live dashboard before deciding whether it belongs in a formal privacy and reporting assessment. It shows where traffic comes from, which pages are being viewed and which goals are being met.

Plausible is a web analytics service that uses no cookies and collects no personal data. It also uses no persistent identifiers or cross-site or cross-device tracking, and does not reuse site data for other purposes.

The public demo provides a working view of its core reporting without requiring an account. Your team can compare the dashboard with its own requirements before committing time to a fuller assessment.

It is a concrete way to judge whether cookie-free analytics can provide the basic traffic, page and goal information your services need.

View the live demo → https://plausible.io/plausible.io

- the Plausible Analytics team
